description: Create a goal for a custom event. eventName is immutable after creation and must match window.xpmetric('eventName') exactly (case-sensitive). (siteId, eventName) is unique — a duplicate returns 409. At most 10 goals can be active per site. A goal for an event that never fires sits at 0 completions indefinitely and reads as broken — add the track call first (get_tracking_snippet) unless discover_goal_candidates already shows the event.
name: create_goal
